name: IOS REVIEW PHOTO OPTIMISATION
changes: Automatically converts and compresses high-resolution iPhone review photos before upload
Accepts HEIC/HEIF selections where the browser can decode them and sends a normalized JPEG
Targets approximately 2.5 MB while preserving up to 2200 px on the longest edge
Shows the selected file size and optimisation state
Bumped the storefront service-worker cache and review script query to 13.8.11
